objective: Preserve immutable convergence evidence while allowing one narrowly-scoped append-only correction when an otherwise semantically identical MISSION_CONVERGENCE_RECEIPT_v1 has only an invalid declared receipt_sha256. Add a versioned supersession sidecar under the existing append-only convergence evidence root, validate that the original receipt remains unchanged, require semantic identity except receipt_sha256, reject ambiguous or broader replacements, and let the existing convergence-aware post-fix verifier consume the correction without weakening append-only history.
forbidden_changes: accepting a supersession when the original receipt is already valid
accepting more than one applicable correction for the same base receipt
accepting semantic changes to objective, requirements, coverage, evidence, gaps, authority, candidate binding, PR binding or merge binding
modifying or deleting any existing file under research/codex/convergence/
